reason: A browser plugin that notifies users when background agent turns finish or require approval, answers, or plan reviews, with an enablement setting and browser permission flow.

summaries.zh: 在页面处于后台时，通过浏览器系统通知提醒用户对话回合结束或代理等待授权、回答和计划审核。
summaries.en: Sends browser system notifications when a background conversation turn finishes or an agent is waiting for approval, an answer, or plan review.

capabilities: Displays browser OS-level notifications when sessions finish or require user interaction
Reads browser-side session status changes to determine notification events
Stores the notification preference in localStorage
Requests browser notification permission through a user-initiated settings action
